subject.title: fix(memory): recover from same-file legacy index divergence

question: Should this exact-head implementation become the canonical landing path for same-file legacy index divergence, replacing the overlapping open implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109865?
rationale: Both branches address the same persisted-state repair boundary, but choosing the permanent migration semantics and the canonical contributor path requires owner judgment beyond automated correctness review.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Review and merge this branch if its partial-source invalidation policy is the desired durable migration contract, then close the older overlapping PR with attribution.

options.title: Consolidate onto the earlier PR
options.body: Port the exact-head proof and partial-source safety behavior to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109865 if maintainers prefer its contributor branch as the canonical review thread.

options.title: Pause for migration-policy review
options.body: Hold both PRs if canonical-versus-legacy preservation semantics need a broader Memory Core migration decision before either implementation lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Review and merge this branch if its partial-source invalidation policy is the desired durable migration contract, then close the older overlapping PR with attribution.
